xBRIEFInfo.description: Confirmed change proposal for the Directive 0.119.5 teaching-baseline upgrade.

narratives.Problem: The repository's authoring pin had moved ahead of the 0.119.2 learner baseline, leaving current curriculum, fixtures, source links, and verification assertions stale.
narratives.Change: Collapse all current teaching and executable surfaces onto the immutable Directive 0.119.5 package graph and release commit, preserving labeled historical evidence.
narratives.Scope: In scope: managed upgrade metadata, current curriculum and solutions, six disposable fixtures, workflows, verifier code, source evidence, tests, push, and pull request. Out of scope: merge, publication, deployment, and changes to the Directive source repository.
narratives.Impact: Learner examples, package graphs, runtime guards, current source citations, and maintenance evidence all identify one release.
narratives.Risks: Mechanical replacement could rewrite history or miss escaped verifier literals. Classify occurrences and run causal, aggregate, content, runtime, and Deft gates.
narratives.Approach: Bind npm and Git release identity, establish a failing coupling test, update current surfaces, re-run disposable learner workflows, and stop at an open pull request.
narratives.Alternatives: A deposit-only refresh was rejected because it would leave learner-facing material on the stale baseline.
narratives.Dependencies: Directive 0.119.5 published consistently across CLI, core, content, and types; existing local and GitHub tooling.
